scientific_integrity: Unbiasedness, equalizer property, saddle lower bound and uniqueness are analytically proved; finite quadrature checks independently exercised explicit formulas. No independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only among one-point absolutely-continuous importance-control rules with centered deterministic control. No claim of global single-evaluation minimax optimality for nonlinear estimators or singular sampling laws. Published precedence is limited by accessible specialist literature.
title: Sharp one-evaluation importance-control quadrature for bounded monotone functions
